status: bounded pilot; restricted action grammar; per-stratum representative quotas
limitations: Named Markdown task specification and documented numeric pilot were unavailable.
Symbolic TCP reference is a conservative Linux-inspired abstraction, not a version-complete kernel clone.
Generation uses full prefixes; selected plans are not exhaustive or proven globally optimal.
Two total incarnations, one pending reply; no segmentation/reassembly or arbitrary payload model.
Wait units are abstract and require calibration; TIME_WAIT fast reuse and TCP options are excluded.
Fresh disjoint ISN windows; attacker colors consumed without replacement. TCP_DEFER_ACCEPT disabled (baseline enabled it).
Immediate modeled TCP readout ACK; no application/TLS response or censorship interference simulated.
No empirical DPI labels, reference fingerprints, entropy, or pair separation can be inferred offline.

fixtures.purpose: offline TLS1.2 ClientHello framing fixture, one TCP segment; no transmission code
fixtures.hostnames: Equal-length placeholders. Neither name has measured censorship status. Replace with calibrated equal-length names before empirical use.
fixtures.tls: TLS1.2 ClientHello; ECDHE_RSA_AES_128_GCM_SHA256; secp256r1; null compression; SNI and signature algorithms
fixtures.limitations: Framing only; TLS negotiation and server application replies are not simulated.

cpn_export.semantics: same endpoint.step oracle used by offline search; ordered wire-event expansion
cpn_export.visible_projection_semantics: Complete source projection is consumed on first wire event; complete target projection restored on last event. Intermediate states lock the macro-action.
cpn_export.cost_note: CPN counts each physical wire event. A,W depend on complete search prefix and are applied by search.py.
exclusions: full-prefix search labels are external to endpoint marking

cpn_verification.scope: independent literal-colored-token replay of exported XML; not native GreatSPN syntax/runtime validation
